reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is to integrate DSH with external OpenAI Codex services by handling account subscriptions and exposing Codex-based tools. Evidence from the README and package metadata shows OAuth account management plus web search and image generation features, indicating an external-service utility rather than internal code-generation or project-analysis tooling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于在 DSH 中管理多账号 OpenAI Codex 订阅，并提供模型调用、联网检索与图片生成等外部服务能力。
summaries.en: This DeepSeek Harness plugin lets DSH users manage multiple OpenAI Codex subscriptions and use Codex services, including model access, web search, and image generation tools.

capabilities: Manage and switch among multiple OpenAI Codex subscriptions/accounts in DSH
Supports OAuth-based account login/credential handling for Codex
Exposes Codex as a selectable model provider in DSH

reasons.code: README states the plugin lets users manage a pool of OpenAI subscriptions and adds Websearch and Image Generation tools.
Package description explicitly lists multi-account OpenAI Codex OAuth, usage, web search, and image generation.
README tutorial references signing into OpenAI Codex in DSH settings and selecting it as the provider in the Models tab.
